# Emerald Armor
This mod adds Emerald Armor and tools into minecraft.

The armor and tools are at sort of iron level.

If you want more armor types on a server, realm, or world, or just your singleplayer world.
you can use this mod!

## Other Info:
- this mod was made in MCreator 2025.3
- it is my second mod.
- it is only for forge 1.20.1
- it can be used on survival.
